purpose: Teach: 高まり/渡さ/覆わ/広まっ/害する/根ざし/崩す/利か

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、関心の高まりを警察も注視しております
lines.en: We at the police department are monitoring the growing public interest in this case closely.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Steady delivery—not rushed. Slight formal distance; this is an official statement. The cadence of someone who has given this kind of briefing before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人に何も渡さない方針ですね
lines.en: So the policy is not to give the perpetrator anything, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Testing his understanding. Leans forward slightly on 「何も渡さない」. Not challenging—seeking clarity on a serious point.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 現場が雪に覆われていたと警察は記録しております
lines.en: The scene was snow-covered, according to our records.
lines.style: Factual, unadorned. Each detail delivered with equal weight. Matter-of-fact pace. No emphasis—just stating what the record shows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、SNSで広まった噂を警察も把握ですね
lines.en: The rumors that spread on social media—the police are aware of those, I assume.
lines.style: Gentle question, not an accusation. Pause before the final clause. He's checking: does the police know what everyone else knows? Respectful but probing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 利益を害する行為を警察は摘発しております
lines.en: We're actively investigating anyone engaging in acts that would harm the individuals involved.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. Slight emphasis on 「摘発」 to show active enforcement. Controlled pace. The tone of someone laying down a clear boundary.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地域に根ざした団体を警察も知っておられますね
lines.en: The community organizations with deep roots in the area—you're familiar with those as well, aren't you?
lines.style: Respectful question, slightly softer than before. He's building on what he's learned. Inquisitive but deferential. Pause at the end—inviting confirmation, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 治安を崩す動きを警察は警戒しております
lines.en: We're watching closely for any movements that could destabilize the public order.
lines.style: Measured, cautious. Each phrase carefully chosen. Professional weight. Not alarmist, but clearly serious. The tone of someone whose job is to anticipate problems.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、規制が利かない地域、警察も対応中ですね
lines.en: And in areas where regulations don't have much grip, the police are already on that, right?
lines.style: Quiet, almost trailing off at the end. Gentle confirmation-seeking, not accusatory. A long breath before the final clause. The sound of someone piecing things together out loud.
